objective: A portable, all-printable tabletop dexterity game called Comet Heist: players launch captured comets through moving gravity gates into scoring vaults in fast replayable rounds, with tactile setup, surprising bank shots, one- or two-player rules, and no purchased hardware.
public_summary: A portable, all-printed tabletop dexterity game for one or two players: pulse two gravity gates, flick a comet through both portals, and bank into pip-marked vaults across six shots.
